notes: repetition_penalty, top_k, top_p and temperature are set explicitly on every call so the model's bundled generation_config defaults cannot leak in. The effective generation config is written next to every generation file.
The three seeds change ONLY the sampling random state of the single trained adapter. They measure generation variability, not training-seed variability.
An output that does not end with an end-of-turn token within max_new_tokens is recorded with finished=false and scored as invalid.
